fields.title: Full-resolution enlarged-shell 3D estimate exceeds the ceiling
fields.issue: At1.04mm edge size, quadratic R_mid/tc40 model has582168 elements and8263917 free equations. Even10000bytes/equation implies76.96GiB, above32GiB maximum. Completed coarse3D runs are numerical crosschecks, not that full-resolution nonlinear result. This is a sizing projection, not a measured peak at that resolution; the full-resolution model was not launched.
